title: Implement Podio Authentication Function
description: Create function to authenticate with Podio using app_id, app_token, and client credentials. Must accept appId and appToken parameters, read PODIO_CLIENT_ID and PODIO_CLIENT_SECRET from environment, make POST request to /oauth/token/v2 with grant_type: app, return access_token on success, and handle all error cases (invalid credentials, network errors, etc.).
details: Sprint 2 - Podio Authentication. Core authentication layer for all Podio API calls.
testStrategy: Test with valid credentials, invalid credentials, missing env variables, network errors, verify token format.
